scope: English presentation corrections; no inference or email
protected_inventory_definition: Tracked files under either November 3 skill-discovery study with a data, results, evidence, configs, source-measured, source-original or validation path component, sorted by git ls-files; compare bytes to base_commit.

synthetic_tests.linux_adapter: Only the working OAuth module os.name is modeled as nt for serialized synthetic listener tests. HTTP, token exchange and storage remain mocked. Real os.name/pathlib remain Linux; Windows DPAPI roundtrips remain skipped.
synthetic_tests.unadapted_linux_result: Two existing Windows-only listener tests fail in each suite because login exits before the listener; the same two failures were reproduced with the unchanged baseline helper.

regeneration.private_profile_review_not_replayed: Historical review_profiles.py requires private response captures/runtime logs. Its translation-only changes were compiled and its AST structure checked; validate_profiles_public.py passed.

limitations: No model inference or email was performed.
Public OAuth SQLite files and private raw captures are not distributed; public validation does not claim a new OAuth database or raw-normalization replay.
Windows DPAPI cannot be exercised on Linux.
The language review is not a formal proof that every possible wording error is absent.
corrections: Gate exclusions are per model; 60 across each of 18 initial-series plans yields 1,080 rows.
32K is scoped to the initial local series; separate v3 contexts and KV conditions stay explicit.
Metric recalculation is distinguished from local CSV/SQLite consistency checks and OAuth CSV reproduction.
Pending inference transaction 100:1 was not retried and its outcome remains uncertain.
Gold labels, closure wording and the P@10 ceiling are clarified without changing results.
Residual French diagnostic report labels, generator fallbacks and working OAuth error messages are translated.
